info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Investment Portfolio Deposits-v4-spec
info.description: The Investment Portfolio Deposit API allows users to access and retrieve detailed information on deposits within their investment portfolios. This endpoint provides a comprehensive list of all deposits, enabling effective portfolio management and decision-making. Typical consumers include financial analysts, portfolio managers, and investors who need to monitor their investments. By utilizing this API, users can gain insights into their deposit activities, ensuring they make informed and strategic financial choices.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the details of deposits associated with their portfolio. It provides insights into current deposit balances and related transaction history.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate a portfolio deposit operation. The user must provide the required details in JSON format to successfully execute the deposit request.
